chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Muḥammad ibn al-Sukayn, from Nūḥ ibn Darrāj, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) saying: “The likeness of the weapon among us is only like the Ark among Banī Isrāʾīl. Wherever the Ark turned, the kingdom turned; so wherever the weapon turns among us, knowledge turns.”

key_terms.التَّابُوتِ: the Ark; the emblem of divinely supported rule among Banī Isrāʾīl
key_terms.السِّلَاحِ: the weapon; a sign of inherited authority among the Ahl al-Bayt (عليهم السلام)
key_terms.الْعِلْمُ: the knowledge; divinely inherited knowledge linked to legitimate leadership
key_terms.الْمُلْكُ: the kingdom; rightful dominion or authority
key_terms.بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: the Children of Israel, cited here as a historical analogy

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام) describe the relationship between the weapon of the Ahl al-Bayt and divine authority?
ai.summary: This hadith likens the weapon of the Ahl al-Bayt (عليهم السلام) to the Ark among Banī Isrāʾīl as a sign bound to rightful authority. It indicates that the divinely designated authority and the inheriting knowledge are found wherever this emblem of succession is found among them.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Al Sukeyn, from Noah Bin Darraj, from Abdullah Bin Abu Yafour who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘But rather an example of the weapons among us<sup>asws</sup> is an example of the Ark among the Children of Israel. Wherever the Ark went to, the Kingdom went. So wherever the weapons go to among us<sup>asws</sup>, the Knowledge would come along with it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Muhammad ibn al-Sukayn from Nuh ibn Darraj from ‘Abdallah ibn abu Ya‘fur who has said that he heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say the following.

“The case of the Armaments with us is like the case of the Ark with the Israelites. Wherever the Ark would go kingdom would also follow. Wherever the Armaments go among us knowledge (leadership with Divine authority) also follows it.”
